plugins.name: AiiDA results
plugins.summary: Open AiiDA nodes by PK or UUID: load("aiida:1234") for structures, trajectories, bands, workflows and aiida-phonopy results
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Reads the AiiDA profile you use with verdi (local SQLite or PostgreSQL; no daemon or RabbitMQ), or one on another machine over SSH (aiida://user@host/1234; nothing installed there). A WorkChain or WorkGraph PK opens its trajectory (restarts joined), phonons, bands or structures; aiida-phonopy results become phonon modes through ewald-phonopy (pip install 'ewald-aiida[phonopy]'). python -m ewald_aiida tree/find browses the provenance graph. Read-only. Phonons need ewald-phonopy >= 0.2.1. Needs an EWALD with reader schemes (after 2026-10-19).

plugins.name: Phonons (phonopy, VASP)
plugins.summary: Phonon modes from phonopy and VASP IBRION=5-8, band structures, and the PhononMode animation
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Reads phonopy band.yaml / mesh.yaml / qpoints.yaml with eigenvectors, VASP OUTCARs of IBRION=5-8 runs, and phonopy.yaml with FORCE_SETS or FORCE_CONSTANTS (phonopy computes the bands along the seekpath path). PhononMode animates one mode over a period with the pattern as arrows; in the GUI the band structure is a plot where clicking a band plays that mode. Installs phonopy and seekpath. Was part of EWALD before 2026-10-19.

plugins.name: PLUMED collective variables
plugins.summary: Collective variables from PLUMED over a trajectory, COLVAR files and metadynamics free energy surfaces
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Plumed runs a plumed.dat over the trajectory through PLUMED's MD-engine interface (values match plumed driver); LoadColvar aligns an existing COLVAR with the frames; FreeEnergySurface sums a HILLS file as plumed sum_hills does. Adds the Claude tools compute_plumed_cvs and read_plumed_output. Plumed needs the PLUMED library and its Python binding (conda install -c conda-forge plumed py-plumed); the rest works without. Was part of EWALD before 2026-10-19.
